dct_description_sm: Since 2012, this case has been played 195 times.

How do you create teaching videos around rarely performed clinical procedures? We demonstrate how we used a mashup or commercial and home-made video materials, along with a virtual patient case to provide contextually relevant information around performing a cranial burr hole procedure.
